title: Runtime rules that no published schema states
description: Applied to every marketplace file that Cursor reads, on top of cursor-marketplace.schema.json. Each entry in allOf is one quirk: its title is its id, its description says what the runtime does. Every quirk needs a failing fixture in ci/fixtures with "quirk": "<id>". The fixture must pass without the quirk and fail with it.

allOf.title: cursor-source-relative
allOf.description: Cursor installs a plugin from a path inside the marketplace repository. The published schema also allows a remote URL in source, but a URL, an absolute path or a path with .. breaks the install. Use a relative path such as "." or "./plugins/name".
